note: Cultivation ranks and aptitude grades. Figures follow the source text where it states them; see timeline.json for the chapters each is established in.

ranks.name: Rank four
ranks.note: Appears only as a power the player observes, never a player state in this game.

ranks.name: Rank five
ranks.note: Referenced as the ceiling of the forces circling Qing Mao. Not a player state.

aptitude.note: The clan reads an A grade as a guaranteed investment.
The figure the elders use to write Fang Yuan off. The game treats it as the starting budget of a resource, not a verdict.
The clan stops spending on a D grade.

apertureTerms.name: aperture
apertureTerms.definition: The space opened inside a Gu Master at awakening. It holds primeval essence and the Gu worms bound to it.

apertureTerms.name: primeval sea
apertureTerms.definition: The portion of the aperture that can be filled with essence. Aptitude sets its size as a percentage.

apertureTerms.name: primeval essence
apertureTerms.definition: The fuel a Gu Master spends to activate a Gu. It recovers slowly through cultivation and quickly through nothing at all.

apertureTerms.name: aperture wall
apertureTerms.definition: The membrane a cultivator presses against to advance a small realm. Breakthroughs are staged as rituals in this game, never as a completion pop-up.
